body: The other half of it. This program uses path-filename and never cites the chapter that defines it.

author: reek
body: It used to type-check. The type environment bound path-filename as a builtin, so the checker vouched for the name, and the failure arrived at the very end of the build as CDX2040: an unresolved function offset. The compiler had promised a name it had no way to emit, and then complained about the consequence rather than the promise.

author: reek
body: It fails at name resolution now, where an unknown name belongs.
